text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 1: An XGBoost model given ICON-D2 tracks measured power at every generator, across a windy, a variable, and a calm week'
text.tspan: Figure 1: An XGBoost model given ICON-D2 tracks measured power at every
generator, across a windy, a variable, and a calm week

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity, out of fold. Weeks are chosen from measured power alone, never from a weather product, so the choice cannot favour one; see "Data and methods". Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026.'
